split_protocol.brain_mri: Original Cheng patient-disjoint fold 1 test, fold 2 val, folds 3-5 train; PID/fold mapping frozen offline.
split_protocol.lung_ct: Official val merged into held-out test because both use the same 40 studies; new val derived from official-train study IDs.
split_protocol.polyp_endoscopy: Official test retained; exact-image-linked case-group val derived from train because video/patient mapping is unavailable.
split_protocol.skin_dermoscopy: Official test retained; exact-image-linked case-group val derived from train because patient mapping is unavailable; cross-test content reused rows excluded.

position_audit.source: answer only; position column is audit-only and never a fallback

metadata.group_limitations: Brain MRI and lung CT are patient/study-disjoint. Public files for breast US, lung X-ray, polyp, and skin expose case IDs but not patient IDs; those splits are case/content-disjoint only. Polyp train/test share Kvasir and ClinicDB sources.

brain_pid_map.source: Cheng/Figshare cjdata.PID with folds validated against official cvind.mat
